goal: Demonstrate one useful end-to-end outcome within a fixed time and spending envelope.
acceptance: The core scenario can be rerun from its documented starting state.
Mocks are visible; the demo never fabricates a backend response or live result.
A final checkpoint preserves the artifact when time or budget expires.
prompt: Build the smallest demonstrable slice for this outcome within the supplied caps. Reuse existing components, mark mocks clearly and reserve time for a repeatable walkthrough and handoff.
